description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a tombstone transmission utility for Android, which monitors a directory for new tombstone files, and sends them over a VSOCK connection to a host, optionally removing them after transmission.

methods.name: new_tombstone_creation_complete_notifier
methods.description: Initializes an inotify watch on the tombstone directory to notify when new tombstone files are created.

methods.name: tombstone_send_to_host
methods.description: Reads a tombstone file and sends its contents over a VSOCK connection to the host, optionally deleting the file after transmission.
